From the arcade

Tic-tac-toe

Bring a friend and take turns claiming three in a row.

Play Tic-tac-toe →

How to play

  1. Take turns clicking an empty square. Player X starts the first round, followed by player O.
  2. Make a line of three matching marks horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.
  3. If all nine squares fill without a line, the round is a draw.
  4. “New round” clears the board and alternates the starting player. “Reset scores” starts a fresh match with X first.

This is a local two-player game, not a computer opponent. Scores last while this page stays open.
